name: Centro de Datos Provincial / Aguas del Colorado-EMPATEL Data Center
developer: Aguas del Colorado SAPEM / EMPATEL SAPEM / Gobierno de La Pampa
notes: DCD reported the new Aguas del Colorado data center administers La Pampa's fiber network across 1,800+ km and 44 localities; La Pampa government material refers to a Centro de Datos Provincial operating about 500 servers. No MW disclosed.

name: Cirion MEN1 Mendoza / former Global Crossing-Level 3 Mendoza Data Center
notes: Current data-center directory listings place Cirion MEN1 at Avenida/Carril Rodriguez Pena 2331, Godoy Cruz, Mendoza, with 0.60 MW reported by OCOLO. Historical press confirms Global Crossing operated a Mendoza data center before the Level 3/Cirion lineage.

name: Zona Economica Digital de Mendoza data-center attraction initiative
notes: Policy/site-enablement initiative rather than a named facility: DCD and Mendoza press report creation of digital economic zones, including the Mendoza free zone, to attract data centers and other digital infrastructure.

name: Marandu / Provincia de Misiones Data Center
notes: DCD reports Misiones' provincial data center is operational in Marandu's building, about 200 m2, five rooms, capacity for 30 racks, and pursuing Tier III certification. Marandu site describes Centro de Datos/cloud soberano services.

name: Puzzle green AI data center project in Neuquen
developer: Puzzle / Gobierno de Neuquen / IALAB UBA
notes: Rio Negro reports Puzzle is working with Neuquen's government and the UBA AI lab on a green data center project in Neuquen, leveraging energy, climate and land. No final site, MW or construction start reported.

name: Tesla-YPF Luz Vaca Muerta data center concept
notes: Infobae and Minergy report Tesla is evaluating/negotiating a Neuquen data center with YPF Luz, potentially powered by Vaca Muerta gas. Sources stress no closed agreement yet; treated as planned/early-stage.

name: Pluspetrol Cuenca Neuquina modular data center, Bajo del Choique-La Invernada
notes: EPI certification map lists PCN - Data Center Modular Prefabricado DP50K12R40P-W-380-S at Bajo del Choique-La Invernada, Neuquen, Argentina, with ANSI/TIA-942-C Design Rated 3 certification expiring 2027-05-03. MW not disclosed.

name: Data Center Provincial Neuquen / OPTIC
developer: Oficina Provincial de Tecnologias de la Informacion y la Comunicacion (OPTIC), Gobierno de Neuquen
notes: Official Neuquen/OPTIC sources state government digital platforms and private-cloud/AI services are hosted on the provincial data center infrastructure, located at the Complejo Administrativo Ministerial and administered by OPTIC. No MW disclosed.

name: ALTEC Rio Negro Data Center
developer: ALTEC SE / Gobierno de Rio Negro
notes: Rio Negro government/ALTEC pages advertise Centro de Datos/datacenter and managed IT infrastructure services; a government item says ALTEC hosts municipal servers in its data center. No MW disclosed.

name: ARSAT Bariloche PITBA headquarters and data center
notes: BNamericas reports ARSAT's US$70mn Bariloche/PITBA headquarters project in Rio Negro includes a data center; Rio Negro official release confirms ARSAT-provincial cooperation around connectivity and data center services. No MW disclosed.

name: Poder Judicial de Salta Data Center
developer: Poder Judicial de Salta / Gobierno de Salta
notes: Official Salta release says the judicial Data Center/centro de procesamiento de datos was inaugurated for digital case files; Entre Rios judiciary notice says it houses components and storage for expediente digital. No MW disclosed.

name: Salta Cloud / provincial Data Center Cloud initiative
notes: Salta official and trade-press sources describe Salta Cloud as a Data Center Cloud/new data-center initiative for provincial hosting and state technology services, discussed with Huawei. No MW disclosed.

name: Data Center del Centro Civico / Gobierno de San Juan
developer: Gobierno de San Juan / San Juan Innova SE
notes: San Juan official sources describe an optimized government Data Center at the Centro Civico for servers and telecommunications equipment, connected to provincial digital services. No MW disclosed.

name: Data Center La Punta / Autopista de la Informacion
developer: Gobierno de San Luis / Autopista de la Informacion / Agencia de Ciencia y Tecnologia
notes: San Luis official pages and budget documents describe the La Punta Data Center as the core of Autopista de la Informacion and the host for provincial government systems/platforms. DataCenterMap lists Data Center La Punta in San Luis. No MW disclosed.

name: Data Center Provincial Santa Cruz / Subsecretaria de Informatica
developer: Subsecretaria de Informatica, Gobierno de Santa Cruz
notes: Santa Cruz informatics portal says provincial systems are hosted in the data center provincial and that the Subsecretaria de Informatica is responsible for security/administration. No MW disclosed.

name: ASIP Santa Cruz Data Center equipment project
developer: Agencia Santacrucena de Ingresos Publicos (ASIP) / Gobierno de Santa Cruz
notes: Santa Cruz procurement listing records Licitacion Publica 01/22 for acquisition of IT equipment destined to the ASIP Data Center in Rio Gallegos. Treated as a data-center upgrade/equipment project; no MW disclosed.
